subject: Sensitive: Role curation & comms plan for Compute/Serving changes
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Liu <sam.liu@peopleops.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sensitive: Role curation & comms plan for Compute/Serving changes

Team —

As discussed in the leadership huddle, we need to finalize a small, sensitive re-scope for the Compute/Serving pod to better match upcoming Dedicated SLAs. The ask is intentionally narrow: adjust three role scopes (2 IC -> managerized tech leads, 1 manager -> lead engineer) and move ownership of the batching/queuing responsibility to Runtime.

High-level constraints:
- No involuntary terminations or forced relocations.
- Changes roll out only after 1:1s and HR review.
- Some role titles and compensation may shift; we need People Ops guidance on comp calibration timing and any mandatory notices.

Attached: org_chart_v2.pdf (proposed matrix), role_matrix.xlsx (redlineable spreadsheet). I’ve also added redaction_instructions.txt for any docs we send externally.

Ask: Sam, can People Ops confirm the recommended 1:1 script, cooling period requirements, and whether we need to open formal performance improvement steps for anyone impacted?

Marissa/Jonas — please review the role_matrix and call out anything you expect will materially change scope or on-call responsibilities. I need a short manager talking points doc by EOD tomorrow so we can schedule 1:1s early next week.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Liu <sam.liu@peopleops.example.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sensitive: Role curation & comms plan for Compute/Serving changes

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. A few immediate notes from People Ops:

1) 1:1 script & timing: We can provide a templated 1:1 script that covers: role rationale, scope changes, compensation/next steps, and appeal/FAQ. Recommend managers hold private 1:1s before any org-wide comms.

2) Compensation: If any comp band changes are proposed, we prefer to handle calibrations in a small, parallel review (not open to the entire org) to avoid confusion. This takes ~5 business days for approvals.

3) Performance implications: If role scope is reduced for someone actively on a PIP (performance improvement plan), we need to coordinate with your HR partner to avoid procedural conflicts. Provide PIP IDs if relevant.

4) Legal/notice: For a title change only, standard notice is fine. If duties materially change, please loop Legal.

I’ll put together: 1) manager 1:1 script, 2) a short checklist for required documentation, and 3) a recommended cadence for comms. Expect a draft by 2027-05-03 noon PT.

—Sam Liu
People Operations (Employee Relations)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sam Liu <sam.liu@peopleops.example.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sensitive: Role curation & comms plan for Compute/Serving changes

Monica / team —

Reviewed role_matrix.xlsx and left inline comments (see column: "impact_notes"). Quick technical flags:
- Moving batching ownership to Runtime requires a short overlap period with the Serving on-call (2 weeks shadowing) and updates to runbooks. That should be in the manager talking points.
- One of the ICs we intend to re-scope (Alex M.) is mid-cycle in a performance review window. He has a green rating from last quarter but had one ticket flagged for on-call responsiveness in April. Recommend we do not change title until the review window closes in 3 weeks — otherwise we complicate the review artifact set.
- Role templates: I attached a succinct manager note at the bottom of role_matrix.xlsx (sheet: notes) that you can adapt.

I’ll reconvene with Marissa to produce a condensed "manager bullets" doc by EOD tomorrow.

Jonas
Head of Compute Ops

Date: 2027-05-03T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sensitive: Role curation & comms plan for Compute/Serving changes

Monica —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick legal checklist:
- If duties change materially, provide the employee a written addendum to their job description. No need for a new offer letter unless compensation changes or location changes.
- If the change impacts on-call or overtime expectations, confirm local compliance per employee jurisdiction; I’ll need a list of affected employees and their locations.
- Recommend keeping manager 1:1s documented (date + short note). If you expect pushback from an employee that escalates, notify Legal early.

I can review the manager script and proposed addendum — send a redline request by EOD and I’ll prioritize.

Ben Cho
Associate, Employment Law

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sam Liu <sam.liu@peopleops.example.com>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@legalpartners.example.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sensitive: Role curation & comms plan for Compute/Serving changes — Plan and next steps

Thanks all — quick summary and concrete next steps so we can move: 

1) Manager 1:1s: Target start Monday 2027-05-10. Managers will use People Ops script (Sam to deliver by noon 2027-05-03). Managers to document short notes (date + 2–3 line summary).
2) Temporary hold on title changes for anyone mid-review cycle — Jonas to send the list of affected people and review windows by 2027-05-04.
3) Shadowing period: 2-week shadow for batching handoff; add to runbook updates and on-call notes.
4) Legal redlines: Monica to send manager script and sample addendum to Ben by EOD 2027-05-03 for fast-track review.
5) Comms cadence: 1:1s -> optional team Q&A -> org FAQ (post-Q&A). Public FAQ will be posted to Notion with limited visibility.

Attachments to finalize: org_chart_v2.pdf (we will redact names for any cross-org review), role_matrix.xlsx (Jonas/Marissa edits), redaction_instructions.txt (Sam will confirm).

If no objections received by 2027-05-04 18:00 PT, we’ll proceed with scheduling.

—Monica
VP, Product Operations
